prompts.connect: – intake: map the AUE into its elements and purpose records when you are assigned an intake
prompts.instructions: intake is active. When assigned an intake, follow the procedure at resource metaform://intake/procedure, or the intake tool's prompt command; the forms it records are at resource metaform://intake/schema.
prompts.no_intake:
FIRST RUN. Metaform has not analysed this project yet. Handle this first, even if the person asked for something else; tell them you'll get to their request right after.
1. Ask the person once, in your own words: "This is the first time Metaform is running in this project. I'd like to do a quick analysis so I understand how it fits together. You can watch it build live in a browser view on this machine. Want me to start?" 2. If they say no, drop it and help with what they asked. 3. If they say yes, do all of this in order without asking again: b. Start the browser view: the web_start tool. Give them the address. If it fails, tell them what it said and stop. c. Read the procedure (the intake_prompt tool) and the schema (the intake_schema tool). Start ONE fresh subagent and give it both texts, exactly as written, as its task. Do not summarize or reword them, do not split the work, and do not do the analysis yourself unless you cannot start a subagent. d. When it finishes, tell them it's done and invite their questions.
prompts.register_step: a. Register this folder: the metaform_register tool.
prompts.schema_pointer: The schema this procedure binds, metaform.axiom, is at resource metaform://intake/schema, or the intake_schema tool.
prompts.selected_mode:
Selected intake mode: Use this mode to select the analysis and recording destination. The request below supplies focus within this mode. Apply only the selected mode's section. It overrides the procedure's status-based routing.
fresh: Examine project artifacts from the beginning. Call intake_start to open the separate map selected at launch. Do not load the previous map into Recorded. Run Survey -> Root_Purpose -> Trace -> Closure -> Anneal -> Proof. Existing-map status cannot override fresh mode. A finished intake elsewhere does not skip Survey or Trace.
refine: Call intake_start, then intake_show to load the existing map into Recorded. Examine current artifacts, run Task_Refine and Proof, then finish the verification pass on that map.
resume: Call intake_start, then intake_show to load the unfinished intake. Continue its survey and trace, complete Closure, Anneal and Proof, then finish that destination. Do not open another map.
Preserve previous maps, work records, knowledge and memories. Map activation remains an explicit operation. Memories remain project scoped and reconnect at matching addresses. Memory access isolation is not required.

prompts.unfinished: An intake was started but aborted and still remains to be completed.

element.namespace_address: The element's dotted address, formed as the intake procedure says, such as code.timer.kitchen.
element.role: CQU, DE, SE or NE, as defined in the intake procedure.
element.name_length: How many of the address's last segments form the element's name, a whole number from 1, as defined in the intake procedure.
element.name: The element's name as the project calls it.
element.refs: Where the element is found: a list of references, each a key and a value, such as path and src/timer.py.
element.condition: MISS, BKN or OK, as the intake procedure marks a part, or broken, missing, trouble or ok: MISS and missing are stored as missing, not built yet; BKN and broken as trouble, which needs a note saying what is wrong and what corrects it; OK as ok. Recording it again replaces the last.
element.note: Free text about the element, kept beside the map in the critic layer, never in the map itself; an exclusion is a note that starts with "exclude:".
element.same_as: With MISS or BKN, when one defect shows at two parts: the address of the other element, where this intake already recorded it. The finding is then kept once, in that element's ticket, with this part linked to it, so one ticket carries the defect.

purpose.receiver: The address of the receiving element, the RE, that holds the purpose record.
purpose.elements: The addresses of the providing elements, the PEs, that serve the receiver's purpose.
purpose.provider: The address of one providing element, a PE, held by the purpose record.
purpose.purpose: The receiver's operative purpose, the OP, as defined in the intake procedure.
purpose.ef: The encounter function, the EF: what the providing elements do for the receiver, in active voice.
purpose.ifd: sends, receives or both: the information flow direction, as defined in the intake procedure.
purpose.refs: Where the purpose record is found: a list of references, each a key and a value.
purpose.condition: MISS, BKN or OK, as the intake procedure marks a part, or broken, missing, trouble or ok: MISS and missing are stored as missing, not built yet; BKN and broken as trouble, which needs a note saying what is wrong and what corrects it; OK as ok. Recording it again replaces the last.
purpose.note: Free text about the purpose record, kept beside the map in the critic layer, never in the map itself; an exclusion is a note that starts with "exclude:".
purpose.same_as: With MISS or BKN, when one defect shows at two parts: the address of the other element, where this intake already recorded it. The finding is then kept once, in that element's ticket, with this purpose record linked to it, so one ticket carries the defect.
